title: Saucers fly on magnetic lines of force

tellings.quote: That ship and the others that are flying fly on magnetic lines of force.

plain: A man named Silus Newton, speaking around 1950 at the University of Denver in Colorado, said that the flying saucer he described, and the others flying, travel along magnetic lines of force, the invisible paths of a magnetic field. He presented this as something he knew first-hand, and if true it would mean saucers use a form of propulsion unknown to ordinary science.
